scenes.title: Introduction to Newton's Laws
scenes.explanation: Newton's Laws of Motion are three fundamental principles that describe the relationship between a body and the forces acting upon it.
scenes.narration: Welcome to our video on Newton's Laws of Motion. In this video, we will explore the three laws that govern how objects move and respond to forces.
scenes.visual_prompt: A simple diagram of an object on a frictionless surface with a few arrows representing forces.

scenes.title: First Law: Inertia
scenes.explanation: The First Law states that an object at rest will remain at rest, and an object in motion will continue to move, unless acted upon by an external force.
scenes.narration: The First Law, also known as the law of inertia, states that an object will maintain its state of motion unless a force is applied to it.
scenes.visual_prompt: An animation of a ball rolling on a flat surface, with a red arrow indicating the force applied.

scenes.title: Second Law: Force and Acceleration
scenes.explanation: The Second Law states that the force applied to an object is equal to the mass of the object multiplied by its acceleration.
scenes.narration: The Second Law states that the force applied to an object is equal to the mass of the object multiplied by its acceleration.
scenes.visual_prompt: A diagram of a car accelerating on a straight road, with arrows representing the force and acceleration.

scenes.title: Third Law: Action and Reaction
scenes.explanation: The Third Law states that every action has an equal and opposite reaction.
scenes.narration: The Third Law states that every action has an equal and opposite reaction.
scenes.visual_prompt: An animation of two objects interacting, with arrows representing the forces and reactions.

scenes.title: Conclusion
scenes.explanation: In conclusion, Newton's Laws of Motion provide a fundamental understanding of how objects move and respond to forces.
scenes.narration: In conclusion, we have explored the three laws of motion that govern how objects move and respond to forces.
scenes.visual_prompt: A summary diagram of the three laws, with a green checkmark indicating that they have been understood.
